title: Typhoon Champi maintains strength ahead of expected entry in PAR

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Typhoon Champi, which is monitored outside the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR), maintained its strength on Monday morning ahead of its expected entry into the country, according to the state weather bureau. In its 11 a.m. weather bulletin, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said that Champi was last located 1,600 kilometers east of Southeastern Luzon as of 10 a.m. READ: Champi nears PH but will not affect PH directly on Monday Champi was still carrying a maximum wind speed of 175 kilometers per hour (kph), with gusts up to 215 kph.
